topic.summary: Deeper remake, not basic advice. Beats: (1) hook: about 550 reportedly cut in India in a day, laptops and access shut at lunch, shares down about 26-28% (reported; company has not confirmed numbers). (2) WHY: Innodata labels and prepares training data for big AI companies; as AI models need less manual labelling and big clients shift work or in-house it, data-work jobs are the first exposed (say this is the industry trend, not the company's stated reason). (3) bigger IMPACT: India's data annotation and back-office AI support workforce, who else is exposed, what AI changes for such roles. (4) CONSEQUENCES for the employee: income gap, EMIs, health cover ending with the job, visa/loan checks. (5) REMEDIES under the labour codes in force since 21 Nov 2025: Industrial Relations Code 2020 for a 'worker' (not a manager): one month's notice or pay in lieu, retrenchment compensation of 15 days' wages per completed year, plus 15 days' wages paid to the re-skilling fund for the worker; Code on Wages: final dues within two working days; gratuity after 5 years under the Code on Social Security; PF stays yours (EPFO); complaint to the state labour commissioner if dues are not paid. Say which rights depend on being a 'worker'. Never cite the repealed Industrial Disputes Act as current. (6) takeaway: the AI-exposed role question to ask yourself now. Label reported claims as reported.
